page.overview:
Who is Leslie Blitman?

Captain Leslie Blitman was a Starfleet officer who served during the mid-24th century. In 2364, she was the commander of the USS Copernicus (NCC-55632).

In 2364, while on a mission in the Sigma Antares sector, this ship sent a request for additional fuel allotments. On stardate 41417.3, Vice Admiral Maxwell Headroom of Starfleet Mission Operations Division sent a reply in which she denied the request. The admiral advised the starship to maximize its resources for greater operational efficiency. The captain was to acknowledge this order on subspace com net security code 645, code 150 alpha. (, okudagram)
